newsitem.title: USA: Littelfuse Inc to change warrant rights.
newsitem.headline: Littelfuse Inc to change warrant rights.

text.p: Littelfuse Inc said on Thursday that its outstanding warrants would be converted into the right to purchase twice the number of shares of common stock as they currently represent.
The conversion follows a two-for-one stock split of Littelfuse common stock paid on June 10 to holders of record on May 20, the company said in a statement.

Littelfuse currently has outstanding publicly traded warrants to purchase 1,979,9000 shares of common stock at an exercise price of $8.36 per share. After June 10, the company said, its outstanding warrants will represent the right to purchase twice the number of shares currently represented by the certificates at an exercise price of $4.18 per share.
Littelfuse produces electronic, power and automotive fuses.
